validator_caller.meaning: the caller of batchTransfers/rBatchTransfers is the validator role

standard_flows_kyc_gated.meaning: standard transfer/transferFrom/mint/burn enforce the isKycVerified recipient/holder gate (and whenNotPaused for transfer)

verified_holder_has_funds.meaning: KYC-verified addresses hold funds movable by a validator batch call

batch_settlement_moves_funds.meaning: a validator batch settlement call debits/credits balances for arbitrary debtor/creditor pairs

integrator_kyc_guarantee_reliable.meaning: on-chain KYC guarantees relied on by downstream integrators remain reliable (funds cannot reach non-KYC/sanctioned addresses)

assumptions: The validator is compromised or malicious, as the report frames the bypass as a single-key compliance failure.
Standard flows enforce the KYC gate; batch helpers are the only path that skips it.
No concrete amounts, addresses, or transaction hashes are given for the claimed fund movement.

unresolved.description: Report does not give a numeric or address-level definition of 'KYC guarantee reliability' for integrators; the impact is stated only qualitatively, so it is bound as a grounded Boolean observable.

limitations: The impact is qualitative; no concrete amounts, addresses, or observed incident are supplied, so the relation is a Boolean reliability observable rather than a numeric invariant.
Pause-bypass and onward-routing impacts are separate impacts handled in other claim-generation passes and are not formalized here.
Whether the validator is actually malicious versus merely capable is not established by an observed incident.
